name: Luna City Satsujin Jiken
source:
You play as detective in charge of investigation of Luna city mayor murder in 2216 AD. You have both male and female body with a single personality and can switch them on will.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2216年，你將扮演一名偵探，負責調查月城市長謀殺案。你同時擁有一具男性身體和一具女性身體，兩者共用同一人格，還能隨意切換。

［引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]］
